Docs as code

Manage your documentation like the rest of your codebase. Version changes in Git, review with pull requests, and use any coding agent to write and update content.

AI chat in docs

Built-in AI chat lets users ask questions and get answers grounded in your docs, with no hallucinations or generic responses.

llms.txt

Your docs ship as clean Markdown with an auto-generated llms.txt, so every LLM and agent can read them.

MCP server

Expose your docs and API through an MCP server so AI tools can query and execute in real time.

AI-assisted authoring

Tag Fern Writer to draft updates, open GitHub PRs, and keep your documentation in sync with what your team ships.
